variables.variableName: Coumarin fluorescence mean in lateral roots
variables.methodDescription: Bottom-view fluorescence images from the HADES root imaging station are quantified with masks transferred from aligned backlit transmission images. The FluorCam/RootCam hardware uses a 12.36 MP monochrome CMOS sensor, multichannel LED excitation, and motorized emission filtering. Template rows expand over summary statistics such as mean intensity and total signal for the specified ROI in the coumarin-associated channel.
variables.notes: Pixel count is represented separately because it uses a different value type and scale. Additional ROI classes should only be added when surfaced by the implemented pipeline. Expanded from template coumarin_fluor.lateral_roots.{stat} with axes {"stat": "mean"}.

variables.methodDescription: Bottom-view fluorescence images from the HADES root imaging station are aligned to masks derived from backlit transmission images. The FluorCam/RootCam hardware uses a 12.36 MP monochrome CMOS sensor, multichannel LED excitation, and motorized emission filtering. This output records the number of segmented pixels assigned to the specified ROI for the coumarin-associated channel.
variables.notes: Per-region fluorescence workflow keeps ROI pixel count separate from intensity statistics because it uses a different value type and scale. Raw implementation unit 'px' is retained; interpret the public scale as count.

variables.methodDescription: Vendor-emitted average spectrum from PSI PlantScreen/PS Data Analyzer for the HADES VNIR hyperspectral unit. Wavelength-axis columns from the Hc_avgSpectrum table are preserved as exported by PSI.
variables.notes: Store as vector; wavelength axis is the set of wide-form column headers (nm) in the table.

variables.methodDescription: Image-based seed descriptor emitted by the integrated Boxeed module during pre-sowing seed phenotyping. The HADES preparation table uses a PSI-integrated Boxeed seeder for automated seed handling and stores vendor-reported seed descriptors for downstream use; the exact internal derivation algorithm is not publicly specified. This variable records the vendor-reported ellipse-fit residual score.
variables.notes: Vendor public output labels this parameter as seed shape – SSE (sum of square errors). Exact ellipse-fit algorithm and normalization remain undisclosed.

variables.methodDescription: Image-based seed descriptor emitted by the integrated Boxeed module during pre-sowing seed phenotyping. This variable corresponds to the optional vendor fluorescence measurement reported as percent.
variables.notes: Boxeed public documentation lists seed fluorescence intensity (%) only for the optional fluorescence module, not the standard base system. Exact excitation/emission settings and quantification algorithm are not publicly disclosed.

variables.variableName: Peak emission wavelength (425–600nm) in rhizoplane region
variables.traitName: peri-root region fluorescence emission peak wavelength

variables.variableName: Emission spectrum mean in peri-root region (425-600 nm)
